app_fee.value: Non-refundable $30 application fee for graduate admission.
app_fee.quote: A completed application and non-refundable $30 application fee

fee_waiver.value: The application fee is required and non-refundable; no general fee waivers are offered.
fee_waiver.quote: The non-refundable application fee is $30. The application fee cannot be waived.

gre_general.value: Central graduate admissions does not set a single campus-wide GRE requirement; examinations are required only when specified by the academic unit.
gre_general.quote: Academic examinations (e.g., GRE, GMAT) are required only when specified by the academic unit.

toefl_min.value: University minimum TOEFL score is 80 on the Internet-based test (iBT).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language): 80 (iBT)

ielts_min.quote: IELTS (International English Language Testing System): 6.5 minimum

english_waiver.value: Applicants who completed degrees at institutions where English is the language of instruction may be considered for an exemption at the discretion of the academic unit.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants from select countries where English is an official language (https://admissions.ufl.edu/apply/graduate/international) or who have completed degrees at institutions where English is the language of instruction may be considered for an exemption (listed below) at the discretion of the academic unit.
